narrative.northStar: One clear setup task in a native desktop window
narrative.overview: An operating utility that follows the desktop's ttk colors, controls and typography. The folder choice leads to installation, visible progress, and launching Seanime. Native widgets supply focus, hover and disabled states.

rules.name: Preserve operating state
rules.body: Existing library configuration stays read-only during repeated setup. Worker threads report through a queue so the window remains responsive.

dos: Wrap explanatory text and grow the minimum window height with font metrics.
donts: Do not describe the development probe as a complete learning integration.
